sloka: कंदरात् अभिनिष्क्रम्य स विन्ध्यस्य महागिरेः ।उपविष्टान् हरीन् दृष्ट्वा हृष्टात्मा गिरम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५६-३॥
transliteration: kaṁdarāt abhiniṣkramya sa vindhyasya mahāgireḥ ।upaviṣṭān harīn dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭātmā giram abravīt ॥4-56-3॥

translations.english: Coming out of the cave of the great mount Vindhya, Sampati was glad to see the monkeys seated there and said to himself:
